data.notes: The document gives each hotel a main 'Nightly rate' with a season rate from 2026-10-15 and a lower off-season rate. The document does not state today's date, so the main 'Nightly rate' figure was used as the current season rate. Off-season rates (169.34, 84.14, 257.31) were excluded. If the current date is before 2026-10-15, the off-season rates would apply instead.
